title: ON GOING MAINTENANCE
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE NAVY > NAVSEA > NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER > NSWC CRANE
description:
AMENDMENT _ The purpose for the extension of this solicitation is to promote sufficient competition.  

 closing Date 04 Dec 2026 - 4:00 PM Eastern Time.  

  

  

 N00164-27-Q-0013 – ON GOING MAINTENANCE– PSC J054 – NAICS 811310 

 ISSUE DATE 03 NOV 2026 – CLOSING DATE 10 NOV 2026 – 4:00 PM Eastern Time 

  

  Naval Surface Warfare Center (Crane) has a requirement for  

  Ongoing Maintenance  

  S/N: X, Y, Z  

  To include all required materials, labor, and handling.   

  IAW Salient Characteristics.  

 100% SET ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESS 

 Contractors must be properly registered in the System for Award Management (SAM). Offerors may obtain information on SAM registration and annual confirmation requirements by calling 866-606-8220 or via the internet at https://sam.gov. 

  

 This solicitation is being issued pursuant to the procedures at FAR Part 13 as a written .  Synopsis exception FAR 5.202(a)(13) applies and Solicitation Number  N00164-27-Q-0013  is hereby issued as an attachment hereto.  

  

 All changes to the requirement that occur prior to the closing date will be posted to Contract Opportunities on https://sam.gov/.  It is the responsibility of interested vendors to monitor https://sam.gov/ for any amendments, which may be issued to this solicitation.  

 For changes made after the closing date, only those offerors that provide a quote will be provided any changes/amendments and considered for future discussions and/or award. 

  

 Offers shall be e-mailed to  trista.m.ray.civ@us.navy.mil .    All required information must be received on or before 10 NOV 2026 – 4:00 PM EASTERN TIME.
